pr_body:
Fix test to handle the case where all shards are skipped.
We ensure that we don't skip all shards in the can match phase
in order to be able to produce an empty result for aggs.

Closes #70933
pr_comment: I left one question for my own learning but think I understand, just for confirmation. LGTM.

review_comment: For my own learning: this is the special case mentioned in CanMatchPreFilterSearchPhase#getIterator where we add at least one shard index to the set to be queried? And that is the reason why we need to remove that one from the skipped set here in the test?
